title: “Kya family planning after marriage hoti hai?”: Integrating Cultural Sensitivity in an LLM Chatbot for Reproductive Health
reasoning: The paper empirically evaluates the chatbot's ability to handle queries related to religious beliefs (e.g., the permissibility of family planning in Islam) and ethical/normative issues (e.g., gender roles, marriage dynamics, and the ethics of reproductive choices). These themes are central to the paper's core evaluation of 'cultural sensitivity' and are categorized as specific variables in the study's analysis.
